date.source: the results page's own file name (7-19-02), a Friday, in line with the fed's own title histories, which date Larry Stone's Hardcore reign to 7/16/02-7/23/02 and Shane Slade's third World reign to 7/26/02

matches.note: Trauma won by pinfall with the Traumatized.
The Constable won by submission with the Adjudicator (an STF opened the match for Andrews, a newcomer).
Commander, Gladiator and Shadow in a triple threat; Gladiator won by pinfall on Commander with the Blood Gorge in his debut. The XWO chant for Commander and Gladiator marks both as XWO men.

matches.stipulation: Triple threat, winner gets an Intercontinental Title shot
matches.note: Chris Storm won by pinning Crazy Cooper and was booked against The End for the Intercontinental Title on Chaos.

matches.stipulation: Title versus title (Hardcore and United States)
matches.note: Announced as a non-title match, then made title versus title by Stone; Larry Stone won by pinfall with the M.T.V. and held both belts.
The Renegades (J Woods and Shorty the Pimp) won by pinfall when J Woods pinned Dru Jacobs with the Buzzkiller, after Shane Slade attacked Erratic.
Shane Slade won by pinfall after The Unknown attacked Jason Chae, The End and Slade in turn with the Interaction of the Assassin.

date.source: the results page's own file name (7-23-02), a Tuesday, and the fed's Hardcore Title history, which dates Da D'Mon's win 7/23; the page's own opening line says "Chaos for July 22"

matches.note: Debut match; Sikah won by pinfall with a chair shot after Travis Smallz slid the chair in.
Da D'Mon won by pinfall when Stone missed the M.T.V. through a table, and became Hardcore Champion.
The Renegades retained: Shorty the Pimp pinned Gladiator after J Woods hit Crazy Cooper with the Buzzkiller.
Dru Jacobs won by pinfall with the Original Chaos after Slade and Chae used a monitor and a ring hammer on his knee.
Erik Erratic won by pinfall with the Interaction of the Assassin; Zero was still winless on his return.
Trauma won by a roll-up and a fast count from referee Bastion Dulsey, and the title changed hands; The Constable then put Dulsey in the Adjudicator.
The End retained by pinfall with the LegENDer after The Unknown pushed Storm off the top turnbuckle.
The Unknown won by pinfall after Shane Slade hit e.T.o. with the Thin Red Line; The End then turned on Slade and Chae.

date.source: the results page's own file name (7-26-02), a Friday, and the fed's own World and Intercontinental Title histories, which date Shane Slade's third World reign and Chris Storm's Intercontinental reign to 7/26/02

matches.note: Debut; Statis won by submission with the Violent Pacification.
Travis Smallz won by pinfall after Johnny Sikah hit Aurora with the Black Plague from behind.
Golden Hammer won by pinfall with the Golden Steed, taking Crazy Cooper's place in the Last Man Standing tournament.
Shorty the Pimp won by pinfall with the Hater's Destiny.
Da D'Mon won by pinfall with the D'Mon Driver, after e.T.o. had attacked Tempest in the corridor.
Sikah won by pinfall after Travis Smallz handed him a lead pipe.
Chris Storm won by pinfall and became Intercontinental Champion, after Shane Slade interfered and knocked out the referee and a second referee made the count.
Shane Slade pinned The Unknown with the Thin Red Line and became World Champion for the third time, with The End attacking Erratic with a bat; Erratic was not pinned.

date.source: the results page's own file name (8-6-02), a Tuesday

matches.note: Debut; Jahan Iranian won by pinfall with Highway Robbery.
Debut; Johnny Fame won by pinfall with The Fame, and was then attacked with a barbed wire baseball bat by Kuff McSlade.
Debut; Christian Niels won by pinfall with the Stolz-Mörder after his manager Johannes tripped Quinn.
Golden Hammer won by pinfall after a frog splash, having used his golden sledge hammer through the match.
Travis Smallz won by pinfall with the Stranger's Slam.
The Constable won by submission with the Adjudicator on Dru Jacobs after Golden Hammer ran in with the sledge hammer.
Shane Slade won by pinfall with the Thin Red Line after Reeco Suave interfered; The End then shocked Slade and Suave with a stun baton.

date.source: the results page's own file name (8-2-02), a Friday

matches.note: Kris Ryder won by pinfall with the Joy Ryde; Johnny Fame ran in afterward and hit McSlade with The Fame.
Sean Quinn won by pinfall with the Bloody Mary after taking Johnny Molson's hockey stick from his manager "Coach" Gaston Lemieux; Christian Niels then attacked Quinn with a German flag.
Travis Smallz won by pinfall after J Woods hit Shorty the Pimp with a chair meant for Smallz; Christian Niels then flagged all three men.
Bryan Statis won by pinfall with the Recall; Shane Slade then ran in and hit Statis with the Thin Red Line.
Dru Jacobs won by pinfall with the Original Chaos.
e.T.o. won by pinfall with the Even Flow DDT after The End hit Erratic with a lariat; The End then powerbombed Erratic through a table.
Shane Slade won by pinfall with the Thin Red Line in Sykes's return to the ring; Jason Chae hit Sykes with the Y2Chae and The Unknown revealed himself a member of the New Breed.

date.source: the results page's own file name (8-9-02), a Friday

matches.note: Sean Quinn won by submission with a dragon sleeper; the referee counted three arm drops.
LSD won by pinfall with the Acid Haze after Dru Jacobs ran in and low-blowed Da D'Mon; LSD's friend PCP then joined the attack.
Jahan Iranian won by pinfall with the Highway Robbery.
Christian Niels won by pinfall with the Stolz-Mörder, then attacked Smallz with his manager Johannes and a chair.
Johnny Sikah won by pinfall with the Black Plague, in a brawl over the whereabouts of his manager Summer Anison; Chris Storm hit Trauma with his Intercontinental Title belt.
Chris Storm won by pinfall with the Perfect Storm.
The End and e.T.o. (the original FreeLANCERS) won when The End pinned Shane Slade with the LegENDer, after e.T.o. speared The Unknown.

date.source: the results page's own file name (8-13-02), a Tuesday

matches.note: The Constable won by submission with the Adjudicator on Brian Corven; Referee Bastion Dulsey then hit The Constable with a chair.
Golden Hammer won by pinfall with the Golden Steed after The Constable interfered and was put down with the Chaos Haze.
Christian Niels won by pinfall with the Stolz-Mörder, in a bout between two Television Title gauntlet hopefuls; Cyclops Snake returned and ran Niels and Johannes off with a chair.
Erik Erratic won by pinfall with the Erratic Triumph; Dru Jacobs then hit Da D'Mon with a moonsault through a table.
e.T.o. won by pinfall with the Even Flow DDT, then ran from the New Breed.
Larry Stone and Chris Storm won when Stone pinned Sikah after the M.T.V.
The End won by pinfall with the LegENDer, with Benshaw as referee, after Benshaw kept Reeco Suave and Shane Slade out of the match.

date.source: the fed's own pay-per-view index (ppv.html), which lists "Wrestlefest II: June 9, 2002", and its title histories, which date the Television, Hardcore, Intercontinental and United States changes staged on this card to 6/9/02; the results page itself carries no date line

matches.stipulation: WIW World Title elimination match, special guest referee Zero
matches.note: e.T.o. (champion) retained: Mazing pinned Tempest (who broke a leg), e.T.o. pinned Slade, then e.T.o. pinned Mazing with the Even Flow DDT.

matches.stipulation: XWO World Title elimination match, special guest referee Zero
matches.note: Erik Erratic won the XWO World Title: Masked Magician tapped to Erratic, The End pinned Krazy Kris (the champion), and Erratic pinned The End with the Interaction of the Assassin.
Cyclops Snake won the Television Title: the referee first called the match for P.P.K. after FonZo chaired Snake into unconsciousness, then restarted it, and P.P.K. quit to the Crippler Crossface.

matches.stipulation: XWO Tag Team Title gauntlet match
matches.note: The XWO Renegades (J Woods and Shorty the Pimp) retained the XWO tag titles, beating The Constable and Mr. Showtime, then Da D'Mon and Flame, then No Way Out (Scorpion and The Stallion), three straight falls.

matches.stipulation: Hell in a Cell battle royal, winner gets a Television Title shot
matches.note: Sean Brovetsky won, last eliminating Hawk Erickson and The Constable with barbed-wire bat shots to the head; Hawk Erickson powerbombed TeeMac through the top of the cell.

eliminations.note: Thrown over the top rope by Mr. Meaner early in the match.
Taken out by a running big boot over the top rope.
Powerbombed through the top of the cell by Hawk Erickson, who then tossed him over the top rope.
Kicked off the cell, dragged back into the ring and tossed over the top rope.
Hit with a Wykiki Slam and tossed over the top rope.
Tossed over the top rope with a chair.
Put through a table, then tossed over the top rope.
Hit with a barbed-wire baseball bat and tossed over the top rope.
Tossed over the top rope after a Terminal Velocity by Hawk Erickson.
Shoved over the top rope as he entered.
Taken out by Hawk Erickson and The Constable together.

matches.note: Trauma and RaZeR escaped the junkyard fence at the same moment and the referees declared both winners; the fed's Hardcore Title history records both as champions.

matches.stipulation: United States Title Last Man Standing match, special guest referee The End
matches.note: Shane Slade won the United States Title on a ten-count after Dru Jacobs interfered and The End counted fast on Erratic.
The End won the Intercontinental Title by escaping the cage with a top-rope LegENDer, after Erik Erratic ran in and was ejected from the cage.

matches.stipulation: WIW World Title unification match, special guest referee Zero
matches.note: e.T.o. won after Shane Slade and Jon E. Mazing turned on both men; referee Zero hit Erratic with the Zero Tolerance and counted the pin, and Zero, Slade and Mazing revealed themselves New Breed members.
